records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a cute global Halloween mobile game. Generate ONE TRANSPARENT PNG atlas, portrait aspect ratio 3:4, exactly 3 equal columns and 4 equal rows. Each grid cell has ONE full-body isolated small character, centered, fixed bottom anchor at 88% cell height, comfortable transparent padding on every side. There are 12 sprites total, with NO grid lines, NO labels, NO text, NO scenery or ground shadows. Genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the characters.

Consistent art direction: exquisite handmade miniature clay-and-felt collectible toys, softly sculpted forms, tiny stitched and fabric details, charming expressive eyes, cinematic warm rim lighting, gentle cool fill, sophisticated soft 3D illustration. Cute mischievous Halloween, not horror, not flat vector. Clear silhouettes, warm ivory, pumpkin orange, muted jade, indigo, no gore.

Each ROW is ONE Japanese folklore character in three consistent poses; COLUMN 1 idle curious, COLUMN 2 playful BOO surprise with arms/open expression, COLUMN 3 peaceful relieved smile and soft amber highlight. Keep anatomy/costume/props identical between poses.
ROW 1: Kappa, small moss green turtle-like river creature with beak, shell, head water dish, cucumber prop, large gentle eyes.
ROW 2: Bake-danuki, round fluffy tanuki with dark eye-mask, cinnamon fur, green leaf resting on head, small traveling bundle; family-friendly no anatomical exaggeration.
ROW 3: Chochin-obake, cream ribbed Japanese paper lantern with single eye and playful tongue, dark wooden top/base, floating tassel-like wisps, amber light inside.
ROW 4: Kasa-obake, indigo aged paper umbrella spirit with one large eye, tiny tongue, one wooden-sandal foot, curved bamboo handle arms, clear umbrella silhouette.
Must exactly preserve 3 columns x 4 rows with each sprite contained inside its equal cell; no feet, tongues, umbrella edges or horns crossing cell boundaries. All 12 subjects the same apparent collectible size. Camera front three-quarter view.

Original sculptural figure, not a likeness of the real shop mannequin. Upper body from waist up. Three gentle expressions and slight bouquet positions.

RIGHT POSE: peaceful sailing with a gently filled sail, warm amber light and three tiny close golden stars. Keep the same boat and pencil recognizable in all three poses.

countryAtlasHistory.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a cute global Halloween mobile game. Make ONE portrait TRANSPARENT PNG atlas, 3:4 aspect ratio, 3 equal columns x 4 equal rows, 12 isolated full-body character sprites. Equal cells, exact grid spacing, each subject centered inside its cell with at least 8% transparent margins, fixed bottom at 88% cell height. No part crosses any cell boundary. NO grid lines, NO text, NO labels, NO scenery or ground. Real transparent alpha outside characters.
Art direction: exquisite handmade miniature clay-and-felt collectible toys, softly sculpted forms, fine fabric and stitched details, big charming expressive eyes, rich subtle tactile materials, warm amber rim light and cool soft fill. Cute mischievous Halloween, highly polished soft 3D illustration with readable silhouettes. Not horror, not flat vector. Original independent designs, no resemblance to film/game characters.
Each row depicts ONE character consistently in 3 different poses. Column 1 idle/curious; column 2 a playful surprising BOO, arms/props lifted and mouth open; column 3 peaceful relief with smile/eyes closed and subtle amber glow. Preserve anatomy, costume, colors, objects between all 3 poses. Camera front three-quarter view. Include full body and every prop with comfortable padding; all 12 characters should be the same apparent toy scale. No gore, no blood, no nudity, no sacred text. Regional characters below, row order is mandatory.
EXTRA PRODUCTION REQUIREMENT: Make the subjects visibly SMALLER inside cells, filling only 70% of cell width and 72% of cell height. A continuous TRANSPARENT CORRIDOR must separate every pair of neighboring rows and columns. At least 10% cell width of blank alpha on each side and 10% height at top and bottom. No large glow extends outside that safe box. Do not fill the entire canvas with tightly packed bodies. Exact regular cell grid placement is essential.
FOUR ADULT folklore-inspired collectible figures from Mexico, one distinct character per row, no depiction of children:
ROW 1 La Planchada: a kind adult female nurse in a vintage pressed ivory nurse uniform and plain nurse cap, dark neatly braided hair, soft warm tan complexion, carrying folded linen and a little amber lamp.
ROW 2 La Pascualita: a magical adult bridal-shop mannequin with visible wooden ball-joint wrists, classic ivory lace dress, floral headpiece and little flower bouquet; serene elegant adult face and dark wavy hair, an original sculptural design.
ROW 3 La Mulata de Cordoba: a confident adult Mexican woman with warm deep brown complexion, curly dark hair, modest ivory blouse, long rust-red skirt and turquoise woven shawl, holding a small paper boat and a drawing pencil; kind intelligent face.
ROW 4 El Charro Negro: a courteous adult Mexican traveler with a black broad-brimmed sombrero and silver trim, beautifully embroidered black charro suit, warm brown complexion and a little mustache, holding a small horseshoe charm. Original independent design.
Three poses per adult character: quietly holding object; cheerfully greeting with raised hand; peaceful smile. Preserve adult face and same clothing/props in each pose. Keep heads proportional, adult doll figures, full bodies visible.
countryAtlasHistory.resolution: Superseded by separate three-pose strips. Missing portraits were replaced with user-approved story-object avatars; all 40 characters now have assets.
